parsed.reason: The parent asked Hale to watch a full class but sent no link. Hale can only watch a course page the parent pasted, so asking for that page is the right answer. The reply asks one plain question and says what Hale will do once it has the link. It invents nothing, sends the parent nowhere else and has no greeting. 'From that class's own page' is a little clunky, but it is clear and correct.
